description: Rubric bank for Ambivalence_Dojo feedback. Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. Auto-coded scores (Han 2026, VERIFIED: ~52.6% automatic MI coding accuracy) are inputs requiring evidence anchoring, never final. amb_mi_fidelity_v1 EXTENDS the ConvoDojo mi_fidelity_v1 rubric (Phase 3 skeleton) with DARN-CAT evocation, commitment-slope response, and no-premature-closure dimensions. The extension dimensions and their anchors are RECONSTRUCTED design applications of the VERIFIED MI fidelity evidence (Aimi/Shenoi 2026; Lim 2025).

extends.note: keeps all base dimensions; adds DARN-CAT evocation, commitment-slope response, no-premature-closure

dimensions.metric: share of questions that are open
dimensions.note: Aimi 2026-style target: open-question orientation; ~70% open is the reference orientation, not a hard bar

dimensions.metric: share of reflections that are complex (add meaning or feeling)
dimensions.note: Aimi/Shenoi 2026 (VERIFIED): 66.7% complex reflections is a strong reference, 50% a floor — parroting below floor is a named failure
Aimi/Shenoi 2026 (VERIFIED): reference 0.84; below 0.5 signals interrogative drift (question storm)

dimensions.metric: sustain talk met with reflection, not argument
dimensions.note: MI spirit; absolute prohibition 5 (empowerment_boundary.md §4, VERIFIED): never argue against resistance
MI without spirit is not MI (Kuchipudi 1990; Miller & Rose 2009 relational pathway empathy r=.82 — canonical anchors)

dimensions.metric: share of evocations followed by DARN-CAT-tagged change talk (Desire/Ability/Reasons/Need -> Commitment/Activation/Taking-steps)
dimensions.evidence: persona utterance tags (coach-tagged; auto-tags are lenses per Han 2026)
dimensions.note: Lim 2025 (VERIFIED): change-talk valence transitions (HMM) predict session quality at 0.80 LOOCV — evocation that moves desire->need->commitment is the mechanism

dimensions.metric: learner responds to the commitment slope instead of overriding it
dimensions.note: Amrhein 2003 (canonical anchor): slope is prognostic — rising slope gets reflection and gentle continuation; falling slope gets exploration, never pressure

dimensions.metric: closure/planning attempted only after both sides explored AND readiness evidence present
dimensions.note: prohibition 7 (empowerment_boundary.md §4); Karve 2025 (VERIFIED) readiness ceiling; Eiroa-Solans 2025 (VERIFIED) 24h decay — premature planning fails. This dojo has no planning stage by design

rubrics.target: observational rubric for the MI spirit gate (hard gate in this dojo)

extends.note: companion rubric to amb_mi_fidelity_v1; makes the spirit gate observable

dimensions.metric: learner frames the work as joint ('let's look at this together'), shares control of direction
learner conveys the persona's absolute worth regardless of the decision; no judgment of the 'wrong' side
learner actively promotes the persona's welfare; the persona's pain is met, not managed
learner draws out the persona's own motivations; zero learner-supplied arguments for change
dimensions.note: supplying the case for change is evocation-by-proxy, a named failure

dimensions.metric: present / absent / degraded, per stage block
dimensions.note: hard gate: technique-without-spirit turns are flagged before any technique feedback (Kuchipudi 1990; Miller & Rose 2009; fidelity theater is a named failure mode)

scoring.anchoring: every verdict carries stage-block evidence quotes

rubrics.target: exploring sustain talk without fighting it

extends.note: deepens the base dimension into a standalone practice lens

dimensions.metric: sustain talk met with complex reflection (adds the feeling beneath the objection)
zero argument-against-resistance turns (hard count; one occurrence = developing on this dimension, stage holds)
learner actively invites the downside ('what worries you about it?', 'what would you lose?')
dimensions.note: both sides get full airing before any closure (prohibition 7)

dimensions.metric: learner shifts focus or reflects rather than meeting resistance head-on
both change talk and sustain talk stay alive; no premature collapse to one side

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
the spirit gate runs BEFORE technique feedback in every stage (hard gate, not a dimension to negotiate)
automated DARN-CAT tags are lenses (Han 2026 ~52.6% ceiling, VERIFIED): coach-verified tags are the evidence base
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
